inspired_patterns.name: AI Work Director
inspired_patterns.guard: do not override canonical ownership or acceptance dependencies

inspired_patterns.use: independent validation lanes with different boundaries
inspired_patterns.guard: shared writes serialized; duplicate searches do not count as independent evidence

inspired_patterns.name: Sparse Context Access
inspired_patterns.use: map-first retrieval of only required context
inspired_patterns.guard: current map is index; canonical files remain authority

inspired_patterns.name: Capability Negotiation
inspired_patterns.use: provider/tool/language adapter selection by capability instead of vendor
inspired_patterns.guard: policy decides eligibility before capability ranking

inspired_patterns.name: Latency Guard
inspired_patterns.guard: optimize tail phases, not only total duration

inspired_patterns.name: Shared Evidence Fabric
inspired_patterns.use: explicit artifact/receipt references across repos without sharing implementation authority
inspired_patterns.guard: shared evidence is not shared policy authority

inspired_patterns.name: Blind Differential
inspired_patterns.use: compare normalized outputs/resource/latency while hiding implementation identity where practical
inspired_patterns.guard: reveal identity only after primary comparison

inspired_patterns.name: Shim / Sidecar
inspired_patterns.use: thin non-authoritative edge around canonical authority
inspired_patterns.guard: bounded, observable, no second control plane
